items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And when I hired him I put him in the union and he said, you think this job would be steady?

ctx.x: He's still working at Pete Herman's. It's 17 or 18 years now. His only job, his first union job. And when I hired him I put him in the union and he said, you think this job would be steady? I said, well I think so. I mean I couldn't guarantee him but it seems the story turned out to be steady, huh? Eighteen years. Yeah.
Who was in the band there then when you first started, Pete Herman?
